general_units.Name: Archis
general_units.Description: Founder of the Archidons, is a master archer.

Abilities.Name: Roll
Abilities.Description: Archis rolls in the joystick's direction, gaining increased attack speed for his next three arrows and 5 seconds (Required Armory I).

Abilities.Name: Teather
Abilities.Description: Archis rolls in the joystick's direction, priming a tether. His next shot launches a rope that pins the target to the ground, limiting its movement to the rope's length for a short time.

general_units.Name: Sicklebear
general_units.Damage: 15 | 20 vs Light Units (Maximum 3 enemies got 100% damage)

Abilities.Name: Rampage
Abilities.Description: Sicklebear tranforms into his bear form, gaining double health & max health and trample. While in bear form, he knocks enemies into the air when running through them (Unlocking after 10 Sicklewraths have died).

Abilities.Name: Selfless Sickles
Abilities.Description: Call in Sicklewrath. Each additional activation will call an additional Sicklewrath, maxing out at 8 Sicklewraths. Using Rampage will reset the call to 1.

Abilities.Name: Bladebreaker
Abilities.Description: After succesfully blocking an enemy attack, Xiphos's next attack deals bonus damage base on a percentage of the target's current health.

Abilities.Name: Heroic Leap
Abilities.Description: Xiphos charges up and leaps in the aimed direction, slamming down to the ground and deal area damage, knock enemies into the air.

Abilities.Name: Rage
Abilities.Description: Xiphos inspires nearby light units, granting them increased attack speed and movement speed for short duration.

Passive.Name: Combo
Passive.Description: On the 3rd hit of each attack combo, Xiphos deals +15 damage and knocks enemy into the air.

Passive.Name: Way of the Sword
Passive.Description: Swordwraths reduce 10% cost and train 25% faster while Xiphos is on the battlefield.

Abilities.Name: Block
Abilities.Description: Enters a defensive stance that reduces incoming damage but slows movement and attack speed.

Abilities.Name: Clicky
Abilities.Description: Summons Clicky - his Riptor pet, to the battlefield for 45 seconds (Requires Barrack I).

Abilities.Name: Crashdown
Abilities.Description: Likes Xiphos's Heroic Leap, Atreyos charges up and leaps in the aimed direction, slamming down to the ground and deal area damage, knock enemies into the air.

Passive.Name: Way of the Spear
Passive.Description: Speartons train 30% faster while Atreyos is on the battlefield.

Passive.Name: Respawn
Passive.Description: Everytime Atreyos retrains, he gains more 50 health & max health and more 2 | 3 vs Light Units damage. This effect caps at 5th respawn

Abilities.Name: Block
Abilities.Description: Enters a defensive stance that reduces incoming damage but slows movement and attack speed.

Abilities.Name: Ice Path
Abilities.Description: Spearos leaves a trail of ice behind him, slowing enemies that walk on it.

Abilities.Name: Deep Freeze
Abilities.Description: Slowed enemies within range are further slowed. Units already afflicted by Ice Path or another freeze effect will suffer even greater slow effect (Requires Temple I).

Abilities.Name: Ashfall Slam
Abilities.Description: Wrathnar leaps into the air, leaving only his shadow below. Within 5 seconds, he can aim and slams down to the ground, dealing area damage and applying burn to enemies hit.

Abilities.Name: Lava Quake
Abilities.Description: Wrathnar drives his sword into the ground, unleashing a lava-fueled quake in the aim direction. Enemies hit are knocked into the air and take burn damage over time.

Abilities.Name: Heal
Abilities.Description: Restores health to a targeted allied unit.

Abilities.Name: Thera's Ward
Abilities.Description: Summon a sacred healing ward that restores health to nearby allies over time.

Abilities.Name: Flight of the Foretold
Abilities.Description: Thera gains flight ability and psychic protection, shielding nearby allies from death and restoring health when they would fall.

Abilities.Name: Summon Minions
Abilities.Description: Summons a magical Melee minion. (Maximum 2 minions with Temple II)

Abilities.Name: Arc Field
Abilities.Description: Summons a powerful electric field that suspends enemies within its area for 3 seconds. Applying electric effect to each units in that field. (Requires Temple I)

Abilities.Name: Sky Volt
Abilities.Description: Summons a storm cloud above a target unit, striking the area with lightning and dealing area-of-effect spark damage.

general_units.Name: Marrowkai
general_units.Description: Called as Kai. Current leader of The Chaos Empire, as known as Adicai - Atreyos's brother and late leader of the Speartons, when he was alived.

Abilities.Name: Summon Deads
Abilities.Description: Summons 4 Deads rise to fight for him.

Abilities.Name: Hell Fist
Abilities.Description: Marrowkai aims & slams to the ground, causing fists to erupt along a path, dealing area damage and knocking enemies into the air.

Abilities.Name: Reap
Abilities.Description: Sends a reaper to the targeted unit, forcing them to run forward uncontrollably (Requires Temple I).

Passive.Name: Combined with Giantlord Sightless
Passive.Description: When paired in a deck with Giantlord Sightless, they train together. If the pair fall, Kai will continue to fight, while Sightless will limp back to the garrison. When Kai falls and retreats, he will limp back to garrison and retrain together with Sightless.

Abilities.Name: Alphaquake
Abilities.Description: Slam the ground with a massive leg, sending out a directional shockware (Requires Temple I).

Abilities.Name: Dash
Abilities.Description: Dashes in the joystick's direction, dealing damage to enemies in its path.

Passive.Name: Combined with Kai
Passive.Description: When paired in a deck with Marrowkai, they train together. If the pair fall, Kai will continue to fight, while Sightless will limp back to the garrison. When Kai falls and retreats, he will limp back to garrison and retrain together with Sightless.

Passive.Name: Giant Kinship
Passive.Description: All Giant Units have their training time reduced by 25%

Abilities.Name: Roll
Abilities.Description: Kytchu rolls in the joystick's direction (Required Armory I).

Abilities.Name: Focus Flare
Abilities.Description: Kytchu's next shot fires a flare arrow, marking a target location. All Archidons then fire 2 arrows at the marked location, ignoring range limits.

Abilities.Name: Splitfire
Abilities.Description: Kytchu fires 5 arrows that deal stun and damage to each unit got hit.

Passive.Name: Way of the Bow
Passive.Description: Archidons reduce 10% cost and train 25% faster while Kytchu is on the battlefield.

general_units.Name: King Zarek
general_units.Description: Current King of the Order Empires, is the father of Kytchu, Xiphos, Shade, Icaron, Adicai and Atreyos.

Abilities.Name: Banner of Order
Abilities.Description: He plants the Banner of Order on the battlefield, boosting the attack and movement speed of nearby allied units.

Abilities.Name: Golden Attack
Abilities.Description: King Zarek commands his Golden Speartons to strike. They move into attack mode and engage the nearby enemy.

Abilities.Name: Golden Defense
Abilities.Description: King Zarek commands his Golden Speartons to defend. They move into defense mode and defending Zarek above all else.

Passive.Name: For the Order Empire
Passive.Description: While King Zarek is on the battlefield, Order units train 30% faster.

Passive.Name: Golden Speartons
Passive.Description: Commands 1 Golden Spearton Guard (Required Armory I). Commands 2 Golden Spearton Guards (Required Armory II). Golden Speartons are elite Speartons with higher stats and unique golden armor. They will defend King Zarek above all else.

General Passive.Name: Relentless
General Passive.Description: When defeated, limps back to the garrison and begins recorvery (healing). After 30 cooldown seconds, they automatically return to the battlefield with full health (retrain).

General Passive.Name: Elite
General Passive.Description: Only one per player on the battlefield.
